title: Textile ball
author: Marcel Padilla

capture.surface: speckle mat (texture for COLMAP feature matching)

pipeline.training: Brush (built from main), 30000 iters, 500k splat cap

steps: cropped to the object alone, then recentred on its bounding box

caveats: Spherical harmonics were dropped (SH degree 0), so there is no view-dependent shading.
Scale is the COLMAP reconstruction scale and is not metric.
The exact source capture is not pinned, so quality metrics are unset.
